hook.en: The train you take home is run by the government, but the bus company next to the station may be privately owned. India keeps both kinds of enterprises side by side.
hook.kn: ನೀವು ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ರೈಲು ಸರ್ಕಾರದ್ದು, ಆದರೆ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣದ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಬಸ್ ಕಂಪನಿ ಖಾಸಗಿಯದ್ದಾಗಿರಬಹುದು. ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡೂ ರೀತಿಯ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು ಜೊತೆಯಾಗಿವೆ.

objectives.en: Distinguish between the private sector and the public sector
Explain why India is a mixed economy

narration.en: The train you take home is run by the government, but the bus company next to the station may be privately owned. India keeps both kinds of enterprises side by side.
narration.kn: ನೀವು ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ರೈಲು ಸರ್ಕಾರದ್ದು, ಆದರೆ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣದ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಬಸ್ ಕಂಪನಿ ಖಾಸಗಿಯದ್ದಾಗಿರಬಹುದು. ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡೂ ರೀತಿಯ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು ಜೊತೆಯಾಗಿವೆ.

title.en: Two sectors in a mixed economy

body.en: India is a mixed economy where both private and public sectors operate. The private sector consists of businesses owned by individuals or groups: sole proprietorships, partnerships, Joint Hindu Family businesses, cooperatives and companies. The public sector consists of enterprises owned and managed by the central or state government, wholly or partly, to serve national goals.

points.en: Private sector: owned by individuals or groups
Public sector: owned and managed by government

narration.en: India is a mixed economy where both private and public sectors operate. The private sector consists of businesses owned by individuals or groups: sole proprietorships, partnerships, Joint Hindu Family businesses, cooperatives and companies. The public sector consists of enterprises owned and managed by the central or state government, wholly or partly, to serve national goals.
narration.kn: ಭಾರತ ಮಿಶ್ರ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ. ಖಾಸಗಿ ವಲಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಅಥವಾ ಗುಂಪುಗಳ ಒಡೆತನದಲ್ಲಿದೆ; ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ವಲಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಅಥವಾ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಒಡೆತನದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

title.en: On the board: A mixed economy

narration.en: India is a mixed economy: private and public sectors work side by side.

say.en: India is a mixed economy: private and public sectors work side by side.
The private sector is owned by individuals or groups, in all the forms we studied.
The public sector is owned by the central or state government, wholly or partly, to serve national goals.
Example: Tata Steel is in the private sector; SAIL, owned by the government, is in the public sector.

explanation.en: Public sector enterprises are owned and managed by the central or state government, wholly or partly. Private sector businesses, including cooperatives, are owned by individuals or groups.

problem.en: Classify into private or public sector: (a) a cooperative milk society, (b) Indian Railways, (c) a family-run textile shop, (d) a company in which the government holds 74% of the shares.

steps.en: (a) Owned by its members: private sector.
(b) Run by the Ministry of Railways: public sector (departmental undertaking).
(c) Owned by a family: private sector.
(d) Government holds at least 51%: public sector (government company).

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: India is a mixed economy with private and public sectors.
points.kn: ಭಾರತ ಖಾಸಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ವಲಯಗಳಿರುವ ಮಿಶ್ರ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ.

points.en: The private sector is owned by individuals or groups.
points.kn: ಖಾಸಗಿ ವಲಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಅಥವಾ ಗುಂಪುಗಳ ಒಡೆತನದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

points.en: The public sector is owned and managed by the government.
points.kn: ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ವಲಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಒಡೆತನ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

narration.en: Recap. India is a mixed economy with private and public sectors. The private sector is owned by individuals or groups. The public sector is owned and managed by the government.
